description: Write «Честный знак» (Chestny ZNAK) marking codes onto order items, or remove them. Each order item is a single unit and takes exactly one code; item IDs come from get_order under delivery_chunks[].items[].id. Pass the code in full, including the crypto tail; pass marking_code null to remove a previously written code. Atomic: if any code fails the server-side check the whole request is rejected and nothing is written.

items.description: Order items with their marking codes, 1-100 items, one entry per item.

marking_code.description: Full «Честный знак» marking code including the crypto tail, or null to remove the code written earlier.

order_item_id.description: Order item ID (UUID) from get_order delivery_chunks[].items[].id. Must not repeat within a request.

name: set_order_marking_codes
title: Set order marking codes
